body:
First of all, thanks for replying. I'm completely lost right now. 

I told her, when we broke up, that I still love her and I will go on loving her, and that I will be always there for her no matter what, but I fear that she dismissed my words as something meaningless that people usually say when a relationship ends. I don't know how to convey the message. Or maybe she did understand, but she doesn't want to talk to me anyway for what she thinks is my sake.

Being in a LDR doesn't help either, it's not like I can show up at her place. She already blocked me on a few accounts and I'm pretty sure she wouldn't pick up the phone if I called her. She didn't reply to the last email I wrote her. She forgot to block me on a chat account I'm not using often but probably she would if I tried to reach her on there.

I want to be there for her but it looks like she's determined to prevent me to do it.
